svg.title: Cosine similarity: linked pages and length-matched non-links
svg.desc: Distribution of TF-IDF cosine similarity after stopword, character-name, and high-document-frequency term removal.
svg.text: Do linked Marvel pages speak more alike?
TF–IDF cosine after removing character-name terms, stopwords and corpus-wide boilerplate
Each dot is one of 1,411 distinct pairs per group; controls are matched on the pair’s combined article word count.
